name: dp-it-normativa-grab
description: Downloads the Normattiva multivigente AKN export (nuova-ricerca, conferma, check-status, 303 location) of the given acts into <dir>/<actId>.zip with a sidecar <actId>.act.json for the convert class.
author: open-lex-it

execute.description: For each item {key, meta{kind, actId, denominazione, anno, numero}} run the export and write the zip and sidecar atomically. Every item is tried; if any failed the run ends with an error (config_error if any failure is a config error, else transient_error) listing the failed keys. dryRun makes no request and writes nothing.

items.description: the acts to download, as reported by the detect step

dryRun.description: plan only: no request, nothing written

allowedHosts.description: hosts the class may call (default api.normattiva.it, export.normattiva.it)
